package runtimecatalog

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL, InternalToken string
	HTTPClient             *http.Client
}

func (client Client) ListRuntimeProfiles(ctx context.Context) ([]domain.RuntimeProfileDescriptor, error) {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/runtime-profiles", nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("runtime profile catalog returned status %d", response.StatusCode)
	}
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: response.Body, N: 256<<10 + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var envelope struct {
		Schema   string                            `json:"schema"`
		Profiles []domain.RuntimeProfileDescriptor `json:"profiles"`
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&envelope); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 || envelope.Schema != "sandbox-runtime-profile-catalog.v1" {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return envelope.Profiles, nil
}

func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
}

var _ domain.RuntimeProfileCatalog = Client{}
